description: This file defines the PropertyOper class, which extends MakeInStringOperation. It is responsible for inserting the value of a specified property from a resource (properties file) during some operation in the minilang module of the OFBiz framework. It retrieves the property value based on resource and property attributes specified in an XML element and logs a warning if the property is not found.

classes.name: PropertyOper
classes.description: A class for inserting the value of a property from a specified resource during minilang operations

methods.name: PropertyOper
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the resource and property attributes from XML element attributes

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the operation by retrieving the property value from the resource and returning it or logging a warning if not found
